title: Chencres
summary: Raleigh names Chencres in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Chencres, drowned in the red Sea. The table prints An. Mundi 2497. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.
